messages.subject: Project Meridian - Sentvia Vigil draft agreement & order form
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Naomi,

Please find attached our standard Master SaaS Subscription Agreement together with the order form for the modules we discussed (Core Safety, Signal Detection, Aggregate Reporting and the E2B(R3) gateway), 120 users, 36-month term. Our colleagues at Ashworth Quinn are copied and will handle the legal points.

We're keen to get to signature in November so onboarding can begin before year-end.

Best regards,
Priya Nair
Head of Commercial, Sentvia Health Systems

Naomi
